title: Petition of the inspector of wires in the Town of Amherst, Massachusetts, requesting an official interpretation on the part of the Department of Public Utilities as to whether or not the word "suitable" as it appears in 220 C.M.R. 126.36(1), can be properly defined by the local Inspector of Wires as meaning rigid metal, intermediate metal, or Schedule 80 rigid nonmetallic conduit or its equivalent, in regard to the lower eight feet of raceway on the side of a pole when the installation encloses conductors operating over 600 volts.
